title: FW↔ML-001: TFLite Micro Model Handoff + Preprocessing Spec
description: Edge AI/ML hands a quantized model artifact plus an exact preprocessing specification to Firmware; Firmware returns on-target latency/RAM measurements and preprocessing-parity confirmation. Grounded in FIRMWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.3 (Provides/Requires/Cadence).

framework.description: On-device inference framework; AgriSpectra targets TFLite Micro on the STM32H7.

quantization.description: Quantization scheme of the delivered artifact.

model_file.description: Filename of the quantized artifact within the handoff bundle.

sha256_hash.description: SHA-256 of model_file for integrity verification.

tensor_arena_size_bytes.description: Required TFLite Micro tensor-arena size in bytes; Firmware re-allocates the arena to this size before inference.

expected_operator_set.description: Operators the model uses (must be supported by the on-device TFLite Micro op resolver / CMSIS-NN).

preprocessing_spec.description: Exact preprocessing specification with a Python golden reference and test vectors; Firmware must confirm parity bit-for-bit / within stated tolerance.

golden_reference_path.description: Path to the Python golden reference implementation.

test_vectors_path.description: Path to input→expected-output test vectors used for parity verification.

tolerance.description: Allowed numerical deviation between firmware and golden-reference output.

firmware_measurements.description: Returned by Firmware after integration (Provides side of §6.3).

inference_latency_ms_p95.description: On-target p95 inference latency in milliseconds.

ram_peak_bytes.description: Measured peak RAM during inference in bytes.

preprocessing_parity_confirmed.description: True when firmware preprocessing output matches the golden reference within tolerance.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Cross-team interface affecting on-device resource budgets; arena/latency budget breaches escalate to ARB/ADR (Tier-2). Routine parity confirmation is Tier-3.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (model handoff during development); SLA_FROM_EVENT (pre-integration latency sign-off)
confirm_conditions: expected_operator_set is a subset of the firmware op resolver's supported operators
tensor_arena_size_bytes fits within the ML-arena flash/RAM budget defined by ARCH
preprocessing_spec includes a golden reference and test vectors with a stated tolerance
Firmware preprocessing-parity test passes within tolerance
reject_conditions: model uses an operator absent from the firmware op resolver
tensor_arena_size_bytes exceeds the allocated budget (raise ADR — never silently re-budget)
counter_conditions: operator set requires an op resolver update that is feasible but unplanned — request scheduling
tolerance unspecified or ambiguous for a new preprocessing stage — request clarification
